title: Fixing a List of Coordinates
statement: Let $\rho$ assign each of the $n$ coordinates a state that is either free, fixed at $1$, or fixed at $-1$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Starting from $\rho$, process the coordinates in the given list order, fixing each listed coordinate $i$ to the sign encoded by $x_i$; the resulting assignment of states is the fixed-coordinate list.
